Reason for Mistake: From the outset, the plan and subsequent code failed to apply the required filter for numpy.polynomial-specific issues and did not handle pagination. This led to selecting from an unscoped, truncated set of issues across the entire repo, producing the wrong date (08/27/20) instead of the correct 04/15/18.
